text: 卖淫合法，那我们中国的国家合法性何在？
en: If prostitution were legal, then where would the legitimacy of our Chinese state lie?

text: 小巷子里几百块一次非法
en: A few hundred yuan a pop in a back alley is illegal.

text: AI涩图违法，给机器人装福也违法，甚至于游戏虚拟角色露个大腿乳沟也违法，也要和谐
en: AI lewd images are illegal; fitting robots with sexual features is also illegal; and even game virtual characters showing a bit of thigh or cleavage is illegal and gets censored.

text: 但是一个月几万块，住别墅里，长租不违法
en: But tens of thousands of yuan a month, living in a villa, on a long-term arrangement, is not illegal.

text: 不要神圣化生殖器官。
en: Do not sacralise sexual organs.

text: 当力工是出租自己肌肉的使用权。
en: Being a manual labourer is renting out the right to use one's muscles.

text: 当策划是出租自己脑子的使用权。
en: Being a planner is renting out the right to use one's brain.

text: 送外卖、快递是出租自己手脚的使用权。
en: Delivering takeaway or parcels is renting out the right to use one's hands and feet.

text: 当性工作者是出租自己生殖器的使用权。
en: Being a sex worker is renting out the right to use one's genitals.

text: 凭什么生殖器就比手脚、比全身肌肉、比脑子高贵？
en: On what grounds are genitals nobler than hands and feet, than the muscles of the whole body, than the brain?

text: 从重要性来说，最高贵的不应该是脑子吗？
en: In terms of importance, shouldn't the noblest be the brain?

text: 为什么不见有人呼吁从事策划工作违法？
en: Why does no one call for planning work to be made illegal?

text: 感谢各位朋友的厚爱，短短几天点赞这么多，评论区几种常见的谬误给大家展示一下，后面看见其他的了再补充。
en: Thank you all for your kindness; in just a few days there have been so many likes. Let me show you a few common fallacies from the comments section, and I'll add more if I come across others later.

text: 人身攻击——“说这么多，你就是🐞吧！
en: Personal attack — 'Going on like this, you must just be a 🐞!'

text: ”声明一下，本人从未嫖娼或参与色情交易，从未与我老婆以外的女性发生过性关系。
en: "Let me state clearly: I have never visited prostitutes or taken part in sex transactions, and have never had sexual relations with any woman other than my wife."

text: 我是在捍卫男女平等与每个人的自身独立性。
en: I am defending gender equality and every person's independence.

text: 滑坡谬误——“你怎么不叫自己家里人卖？
en: Slippery-slope fallacy — 'Why don't you tell your own family to sell themselves?'

text: ”不是哥们儿，现在掏大粪也不违法，你要不也去掏一个？
en: "Come off it, mate — cleaning out cesspits isn't illegal either; why don't you go do that?"

text: 我呼吁不违法≠我喜欢这个行业，我家里人也有他们自己的脑子，爱卖不卖是自己的事情。
en: My calling for it not to be illegal does not mean I like this industry. My family members have their own brains too; whether they sell themselves or not is their own business.

text: 稻草人谬误——“你叫女的去卖，是不是歧视女性？
en: Straw-man fallacy — 'You're telling women to sell themselves; isn't that sexist against women?'

text: ”我对两性一视同仁，同样支持男人去卖。
en: "I treat both sexes equally and equally support men going to sell themselves."

text: 然而事实上现在的鸭店就是普遍不违法的，觉得卖淫违法的那批人，又如何评价这种扭曲的男女不公平的法律呢？
en: Yet in fact, male-escort establishments are now generally not illegal. How, then, do those who think prostitution is illegal justify this distorted, gender-unfair law?

text: 没那么多高大上的原因。
en: It's not for any lofty reason.

text: 其实就是因为上层需要性生活作为一个原动力来让大家努力打工罢了。
en: It's simply that those at the top need sex as a motivator to make everyone work hard.

text: 你不买车买房付彩礼三金就一直单着吧。
en: If you don't buy a car or a house or pay the bride price and the three golds, you'll just stay single.

text: 如果男人花个几百块就能解决生理需求了，那谁还用得着那么努力工作呢？
en: If a man could satisfy his physical needs for a few hundred yuan, then who would bother working so hard?

text: 你们不努力工作，谁来建设国家啊。
en: If you don't work hard, who's going to build the country?

text: 我支持所有卖淫都违法必究，而不是把外围，海天盛筵，100个情妇，都排除到卖淫范围外。
en: I support treating all prostitution as illegal and prosecuting it to the full, rather than excluding high-end escorts, the Haitian Shengyan, and a hundred mistresses from the scope of prostitution.

text: 那么问题来了，他们敢么？
en: So here's the question: do they dare to?

text: 什么？
en: What?

text: 不敢？
en: They don't dare?

text: 那他们谈什么卖淫非法？
en: Then what are they on about, calling prostitution illegal?

text: 他们定义的非法活动只是穷人花钱啪啪，而不是卖淫。
en: The illegal activity they define is merely poor people paying for a shag, not prostitution.

text: 很多人说卖淫合法就会导致更多的女性受害。
en: Many say that legalising prostitution would lead to more women being victimised.

text: 但问题是按这么说，那些充气娃娃、黄色东西，就应该支持才对，把欲望都转移了，不就没人想迫害女性了吗？
en: But the problem is, by that logic, those inflatable dolls and pornographic materials should be supported — if all that desire is diverted, wouldn't no one want to victimise women?

text: 现实却是，连这些照样也禁了。
en: Yet in reality, even those are banned all the same.

text: 可以想见，制定卖淫非法的人的目的压根就不是保护女性。
en: It is easy to see that those who made prostitution illegal never had the protection of women as their aim at all.

text: 所以有些人就别自作多情了。
en: So some people should stop flattering themselves.

text: 补档
en: Supplement

text: 大家可能不知道的一个很不爽的事实是：现在美国卖yin的中国人越来越多，越来越多，越来越多。
en: An unpleasant fact you may not know is that there are more and more, and more and more, Chinese people selling sex in America nowadays.

text: 你去各大城市massage店走一走。
en: Go take a walk around the massage parlours in major cities.

text: 你去纽约法拉盛街上走一走。
en: Go take a walk down the streets of Flushing, New York.

text: 你会发现。
en: You will find out.

text: 简直了。
en: It's just beyond belief.

text: 卖淫不合法，但100多个小三就合法？
en: Prostitution is illegal, but having over a hundred mistresses is legal?

text: 知乎虽然说是一个赞扬理性的社区平台，但是我这几年用知乎越来越讨厌的就是【假理性的人】。
en: Although Zhihu bills itself as a community platform that celebrates reason, what I've grown to dislike more and more in my years of using it is the 'pseudo-rational people'.

text: 什么叫假理性？
en: What is pseudo-rationality?

text: 就是看起来在讲理性、讲逻辑、讲道理，但是实际上要么【理性、逻辑、道理】都是用来绕圈子掩盖自己的真实观点用的;要么说的人压根不理解自己在说什么,只不过是把自己听到的说辞鹦鹉学舌复读一次,自己的说法之间就互相矛盾.
en: It's when someone seems to be talking reason, logic and sense, but in reality either 'reason, logic and sense' are all used to beat around the bush and cover up their true views; or the speaker doesn't understand what they're saying at all, merely parroting back the arguments they've heard, and their own statements contradict one another.

text: 这就是那些明明很无脑，一听就觉得在扯淡的【假理性言论】能一直很流行的原因。
en: This is why those brainless 'pseudo-rational statements', which are obviously nonsense the moment you hear them, can remain so popular.

text: 随便举一个大家现在都能识别的【假理性言论】的例子
en: Let me casually give an example of a 'pseudo-rational statement' that everyone can now recognise.

text: 刚需自住买房子无所谓涨跌
en: Buying a home to live in out of genuine need means you don't care whether prices rise or fall.

text: 真要是这样，那大家买东西还找什么优惠券，选什么打折时间点？
en: If that were truly the case, then why would everyone hunt for coupons or pick the right discount window when shopping?

text: 那电商平台为什么会推出保价功能？
en: Then why would e-commerce platforms roll out price-protection features?

text: 类似的【假理性言论】重灾区之一就是月经问题，我在知乎经常跟人争论的【pc】【包养】【约跑】合理性问题，【pc违法】【包养合法】【约跑合法】是合理性不可能三角问题。
en: One of the worst hotspots for such 'pseudo-rational statements' is the menstruation issue; and the question of the rationality of 'pc', 'being kept' and 'hookups', which I often argue about on Zhihu — 'pc illegal', 'being kept legal', 'hookups legal' form an impossible trinity of rationality.

text: 如果你支持女性有权处理自己的身体,这个处理权包括交易,那么必须是【pc\包养\约跑】都应该合法.
en: If you support women's right to dispose of their own bodies, and that right to dispose includes transaction, then 'pc', 'being kept' and 'hookups' must all be legal.

text: 如果你认为【pc应该违法】,那么你要么认为这个处理权不包括交易;要么你认为女性不能随意处理自己的身体,应该要有较长时间的接触才能发生关系.
en: If you think 'pc should be illegal', then either you believe this right to dispose does not include transaction; or you believe women cannot freely dispose of their bodies and should require a longer period of contact before having relations.

text: 如果是前者,那么应该是pc和包养都应该违法.
en: If it's the former, then both pc and being kept should be illegal.

text: 如果是后者,那么应该是pc和约跑都应该违法.
en: If it's the latter, then both pc and hookups should be illegal.

text: 你找任何理由都难以解释【pc违法】【包养合法】【约跑合法】同时成立的合理性.
en: No matter what reason you find, it is hard to explain the rationality of 'pc illegal', 'being kept legal' and 'hookups legal' holding simultaneously.

text: 以下这些常见理由只要一两个反问,立马就会在这个不可能三角里自相矛盾.
en: The following common arguments, with just one or two counter-questions, immediately fall into self-contradiction within this impossible trinity.

text: 【pc】是因为法理上认为【金钱交易xx】不能允许，所以定为违法，但按照这样的逻辑，【包养】也不应该合法。
en: 'pc' is deemed illegal on the juristic ground that 'money-for-sex transactions' cannot be permitted, but by that logic 'being kept' should not be legal either.

text: 还是会有人冲上来以【包养】关系稳定，【pc】关系不稳定，可能造成传播疾病来洗。
en: Still, someone will jump in to whitewash it by saying 'being kept' involves a stable relationship whereas 'pc' is unstable and may spread disease.

text: 但是你回复那【约跑】也该不合法。
en: But you reply that 'hookups' should be illegal too.

text: 他立马又不认错，可能又开始转移话题说男女正常对象关系也有金钱往来，很难在现实区分【包养】和【正常对象关系】。
en: He immediately refuses to concede, and may start shifting the topic again, saying that normal boyfriend–girlfriend relationships between men and women also involve money changing hands, and it's hard in reality to distinguish 'being kept' from 'normal relationships'.

text: 然后你再回复那【约跑】也经常有金钱往来，对【约跑】和【pc】的现实的区分也从来是不准确的，怎么区分【约跑】和【pc】那就怎么区分【包养】和【正常对象关系】。
en: Then you reply again that 'hookups' also often involve money changing hands, and the real-world distinction between 'hookups' and 'pc' has never been accurate either — distinguish 'hookups' from 'pc' the same way you'd distinguish 'being kept' from 'normal relationships'.

text: 他又会转移到【pc合法】可能造成黑涩会组织拐卖妇女的问题。
en: He will then shift to the issue that legalising 'pc' might lead to gang organisations trafficking women.

text: 你回复，那按照这逻辑，早就造成过很多次的拐卖男性去黑煤窑事件早就该禁止开煤窑了。
en: You reply: then by that logic, the many incidents of men being trafficked to illegal coal mines should have led to coal mines being banned long ago.

text: 他又会转移说两件事不能比，一个是必要的生产，一个不是。
en: He will then shift again, saying the two things can't be compared — one is necessary production, the other is not.

text: 你再回复，那按照这个逻辑是不是所有娱乐业甚至第三产业都不是必要的生产，是不是所有娱乐业甚至第三产业里只要有可能造成黑涩会组织强迫事件的行业都该禁止。
en: You reply again: then by this logic, isn't all entertainment, even the entire tertiary sector, unnecessary production — and shouldn't every industry within entertainment or the tertiary sector that could possibly lead to gang coercion be banned?

text: 他又不敢回答是。
en: Again he dares not answer yes.

text: 还有典中典的"你愿意你的亲朋好友从事这个职业"论,我的回复就是"按照这个逻辑,不愿意的人一定连包养\商k服务员\台球助教\颜值主播等都不愿意,那么什么时候把这些行业都一起定为违法"?
en: There's also the classic-of-classics argument 'Would you want your relatives and friends to take up this profession?'; my reply is: 'By that logic, those who are unwilling would surely also be unwilling to accept being kept, business-KTV waitstaff, billiards instructors, good-looking livestreamers and the like — so when are you going to declare all those industries illegal together?'

text: 绕圈子绕来绕去，到最后，你会发现，他的意思其实就是【循环论证】，因为【法律现在是这样规定的，法律是合理的，所以这样是合理的】。
en: Going round and round in circles, in the end you'll find that what he means is really 'circular reasoning', because 'the law is currently stipulated this way, the law is reasonable, therefore this is reasonable'.

text: 这种人就属于抬木工的一种，令我厌恶的程度是最高的，完全属于用假象欺骗浪费他人的精力
en: This kind of person belongs to the breed of pointless arguers, and my disgust for them is maximal — they are entirely the type who use false appearances to deceive and waste others' energy.

text: 来展示一下最近刚遇到的典型的假理性人
en: Let me show you a typical pseudo-rational person I recently encountered.

text: 刚开始说“包养没有跟pc一样被禁的原因是难以区分”
en: At first he said 'the reason being kept isn't banned like pc is that it's hard to distinguish'.

text: 然后没过几次回复就为了解释为什么【约跑跟pc的判断可以一刀切，但包养不行】而说出了“约跑跟pc不会判断错，因为说谎的话一审就审出来”的名言。
en: Then, after just a few replies, in order to explain why 'hookups and pc can be judged with one clear cut, but being kept can't', he came out with the famous line 'hookups and pc won't be misjudged, because if you lie it comes out in the first trial'.

text: pc说谎一下就审出来了，但包养说谎不会被审出来，所以包养难以区分是吧，都说出这种话了，还好意思跟人谈逻辑呢。
en: A lie about pc gets unearthed in one go, but a lie about being kept won't be unearthed — so being kept is hard to distinguish, is that it? Having said something like that, he still has the nerve to talk logic with people.

text: 至于有人问,我觉得具体法律这么规定的原因是什么.
en: As for someone asking what I think the reason is for the law being stipulated this way in concrete terms.

text: 我只能问一个问题,你觉得什么理由可以解释对二次元本子也要严格打击的规定?
en: I can only ask one question: what reason can you give to explain the rule of strictly cracking down on 2D doujinshi?

text: 要知道这可是纯粹的可以不涉及任何三次元女性,连形象都不是三次元的,请问打击的原因是什么?
en: You should know that this is purely something that need not involve any real-world women at all — even the imagery isn't real-world. So what, pray tell, is the reason for cracking down on it?
